The '''Upper Pass''' was the name given to the northern pass that crossed the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], with [[Highmount Road]] joining it to the [[Lower Pass]] to the south. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Outpost Onith]] was located at the western edge of the pass, and [[Snowcap Mountain]] sat on the northern side of the pass.
